title: Upper Saranac Lake, Bartlett's (NYPL b11708219-G91F094 097ZF)
blurb: * Views of northern New York including Essex Franklin, Hamilton, Herkimer, St. Lawrence and Warren counties, Crown Point, Elizabethtown, Hadley, Herkimer, Keeseville, Loon Lake, Malone, Massena, North Elba, Ogdensburg, Pickleville, Port Henry, Potsdam, Warrensburgh, Wells, Wevertown, including the fort at Crown Point, Burgoyne's headquarters, and views of the Adirondacks including hotels, resorts, lakes, rivers, other mountain scenery, and boating, camping and hunting, and a bridge being built. Includes views by G. W. Baldwin, Seneca Ray Stoddard, R. A. Miller and other photographers and publishers. One view is of a drawing or painting of an "Affable Adirondacks Agent." Robert Dennis Collection of Stereoscopic Views. Title devised by cataloger.
cond: Rectified 2026. Halves registered to 0.14% vertical error and 0.0° of rotation. Depth measured deep (2.32% of frame width); hung in the VR Parlor at full size.
